column2: Commodus becomes Roman emperor.
Septimius Severus becomes Roman emperor.
Caracalla becomes Roman emperor.
Diocletian becomes Roman emperor.
Chandragupta II becomes emperor of the Gupta Empire, which reaches its golden age under him.
Kumaragupta I becomes emperor of the Gupta Empire.
Skandagupta, the last great Gupta emperor, comes to the throne.
Battle of Mount Badon. According to legend, British forces led by King Arthur defeated the invading Saxons.
Khosrau I becomes Shah of Persia.
Hormizd IV becomes Shah of Persia.
Maurice becomes Roman emperor.
Emperor Xuanzong ascends the throne of Tang China, beginning a period regarded as one of the dynasty's high points.
The Treaty of Tudmir is signed between Abd al-Aziz, commander of the Muslim troops invading Spain, and Theodemir, the Christian ruler of a region in the south.
Alfred the Great begins his reign in Wessex.
The Kingdom of Portugal gains independence from the Kingdom of Leon at the Battle of Sao Mamede.
The Battle of Mansurah ends in a decisive victory for the Egyptians, forcing the surrender of the Crusaders and their departure from Egypt.
Dante Alighieri completes the Divine Comedy shortly before his death.
The Onin War breaks out in Japan, beginning the Sengoku period of civil war.
Suleiman the Magnificent becomes Ottoman sultan, beginning the reign that marks the zenith of the empire.
Babur founds the Mughal Empire in northern India.
Abbas I becomes shah of Persia, beginning the reign that marks the zenith of the Safavid dynasty.
Jahangir becomes Mughal emperor on the death of his father Akbar.
Jamestown, the first permanent English settlement in North America, is founded in Virginia.
The Qianlong Emperor ascends the throne of China, and oversees a huge expansion in territory.
Catherine the Great seizes the Russian throne.
Mount Mayon in the Philippines erupts catastrophically, burying the town of Cagsawa.
The Mi Amigo, the ship housing pirate radio station Radio Caroline, sinks off the English coast.
